components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 32rem; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--trade-border-subtle, #2a2a2d); border-radius: var(--trade-radius-panel, 16px); background: var(--trade-bg-surface, #141416); color: var(--trade-text-primary, #f4f4f5); font-family: 'Inter Variable', 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel-head p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--trade-text-muted, #85858b); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-panel-figure, .ds-num { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; } .ds-panel-figure { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-venue { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.5rem 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-bar { display: block; height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--trade-bg-raised, #1c1c1f); } .ds-bar > span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--series-a, #2e5cff); } .ds-venue[data-path='stellar-amm'] .ds-bar > span { background: var(--series-b, #8fa6ff); }

narrative.northStar: A quiet overview with details on demand
narrative.overview: A 70/30 area-chart and metrics card with a floating divider, differentiated venue bar blues, strict UTC table dates, hover-only row backgrounds, and compact transaction disclosures with Mainnet explorer links.
keyCharacteristics: Preserve the existing Lumix dark shell, palette, and fonts.
No timeframe selector, period query, chart axes, or gridlines.
Venue names and bars only, in two explicit groups.
Rich swap amounts, route summaries, values, hashes, and strict YYYY-MM-DD UTC dates, without a Status column.
Drawers show copyable Mainnet transaction hash, execution venue, protocol/hop summary, and transfer amounts; no trader account, ledger, or UTC timestamp sections.

rules.name: Preserve the Lumix world
rules.body: Keep the inherited palette, fonts, design-system package, header, and footer.

rules.name: Clean overall chart
rules.body: 7:3 chart/metrics split, a blue stroke with 24%-to-transparent area fill, and a floating vertical hairline. No visible axes, ticks, gridlines, period controls, or legend.

rules.name: Grouped venues, bars only
rules.body: Five aggregator venues and two Stellar AMM venues. No dollar amounts or percentages.

rules.name: Details on demand
rules.body: Rich summary rows, no Status column. Native accessible disclosures for the requested on-chain facts.

dos: Keep the footer risk disclaimer verbatim.
Keep search and pagination usable by keyboard and on mobile.
donts: Do not restore timeframe controls, advanced filters, source badges, chart metric switches, or a Status column.
Do not change Inter to satisfy the generic font detector.
Do not imply fixture data is a verified live integration.
